description: Compared to the cyborgs you've seen elsewhere, this one looks almost inverted.  Its body is made of smooth, segmented, paper-thin metallic plates; fleshy protrusions and bits of bone jut from components growing off this base frame.  In place of one hand is a wired airgun.  It moves with dire purpose, like a trained combat machine.

special_attacks.description: The fleshborg launches a bony dart at you!
